_comment: Piste polygon DERIVED BY MEASUREMENT from fencing_clip7a.mp4 by derive_piste.py, not placed by eye. Frame 1280x720. Sampled 540 frames; 75 of them contain people besides the two fencers. Fencer feet y measured in [454.1, 719.8], p1=470.8, p99=717.5. Edges are those percentiles plus a margin of 32.6 px, which is 0.1 of the median fencer height of 325.6 px.
